segments.title: Tallest mountain, base to peak? NOT Everest
segments.say: The tallest mountain on Earth is not Everest. Measured from base to peak, is it K2, Mauna Kea, or Kilimanjaro? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's Mauna Kea!
segments.say: It's Mauna Kea, in Hawaii! About ten thousand two hundred meters, base to peak.

segments.title: Most of it is UNDERWATER
segments.say: About six thousand meters of it is under the ocean.

segments.title: Everest keeps one title
segments.say: Everest is still the highest mountain above sea level.

segments.sub: Should Mauna Kea get the title?
segments.say: Should Mauna Kea get the title? Comment below.
